stage: Necessary synthetic magnitude-estimator gate, before Italian sequence definitions or real response fitting
prior_exposure: CLASS/HORUS source counts, provenance, identity and timestamp audit are known. HORUS paper reports national b-values and conversion artefacts; these were read as methods background. No Italian cluster, Mc, b, D2 or regression has been calculated here.
target: Log-orthopolic rupture territory predicts b=D2/2 versus b=1. Test b=1 and 1.5, the distinct magnitude marginals for ideal planes and volumes. This is not an end-to-end D2/regression validation.

source.paper: Lolli, Randazzo, Vannucci and Gasperini (2020), doi:10.1785/0220200148, Tables 7 and 9; author manuscript pages 35 and 37 (PDF pages 37 and 39), equation 4 on manuscript page 13

observation_model: Mtrue = lower + Exponential(rate=b ln(10)). Source magnitude = (Mtrue-intercept)/true_slope + Normal(0,source_sigma), rounded to 0.1; true_slope defaults to the published slope. Published proxy = round(intercept + nominal_slope * rounded_source, 2). The registered pipeline rounds that proxy to 0.1, estimates MAXC+0.2, selects inclusively with 1e-9 tolerance and applies its 0.05 bin correction. Normal error, hard lower support and homogeneous single-proxy populations are declared simulation assumptions, not claimed facts about Italy. No jitter, ML/Md averaging, detection-time variation, direct-measurement switching, geographical errors or source-mixture frequencies are fitted.
uncertainty: Use the registered 500-resample conditional iid bootstrap SE, implemented by multinomial resampling of observed rounded-bin counts (same distribution as event resampling). For coverage diagnostics only use b_hat +/- 1.96 SE; these are not new registered real-data b intervals. Record mean bias, RMSE, Monte Carlo standard errors, Wilson coverage intervals and eligibility rate in each cell. Common calibration slopes are perturbed by +/-1.96*0.016 in two separate diagnostic cells; event bootstrap cannot estimate this shared uncertainty.
analytic_check: Independently enumerate rounded source-bin probabilities from exponential or exponentially modified Gaussian CDFs, transform bins and compute infinite-population MAXC+0.2 and Aki-Utsu limit. Retain tail mass below 1e-12; record mode gap because sample modes can fluctuate. An exact geometric source-grid point estimate is a diagnostic only, with no automatic estimator replacement.

gate.rule: Every cell of every model marked gate=true must pass all three thresholds. These are engineering validation criteria, not a multiple-testing hypothesis claim. Failure ends this bounded Italian attempt before real sequence construction or Mc/b/D2 fitting. Passing is necessary, not sufficient: clustering and shared-calibration uncertainty would still need validation and a separate freeze.
gate.failure_scope: A failed single-proxy scenario does not prove every real mixture is biased, reject either physical prediction, or rule out a revised estimator. Do not tune gates, exclude failed scenarios or promote the diagnostic grid estimator within this run.

covariance_caution: Table 9 prints post-2011 ML SEs 0.065 and 0.016 with covariance -0.0011. Their product is 0.00104, so the printed matrix is not positive semidefinite. Do not silently clip it or claim joint coefficient-uncertainty propagation. The marginal slope perturbation is a sensitivity, not such a propagation.
provenance: Config, protocol and implementation must be committed before the validation ensemble runs. Raw Italian data are not an input to this runner. Retain results and append a simulation-only registry record, preserving all earlier records.
